To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a facile approach for self assembly of protein into nanoparticles for anti-tumor drugs delivery by harnessing the protein unfolding at elevated temperature.
a facile method of crosslinker free protein self assembly has been developed to formulate nanoparticles with controlled release and cytotoxicity profile.

we have formulated crosslinker free nanoparticles of BSA and paclitaxal (PTX) using a Resolution IV design and the mathematical models developed for the response variables were validated with 4 experimental points.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a novel method for the preparation of nanoparticles using heat induced self assembly of proteins and drugs, without the need of any crosslinking agents or surfactants.
the optimization of various parameters for the self-assembly of a hydrophobic drug, PTX with BSA using temperature as the driving force.
the optimization of the factors responsible for the self assembly of BSA with PTX.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
heat induced BSA self assembly is an effective approach to formulate nanoparticles of hydrophobic drugs like PTX.
the present investigation has successfully developed a facile approach for cross-linker free protein self-assembly into nanoparticles for drug delivery.

the Resolution IV design has been successfully used to optimize the factors responsible for the formation of PTX-encapsulated BSA nanoparticles, and the nanoparticles obtained showed good potential for anti-cancer therapy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have used a Resolution IV design to systematically study the effect of 6 independent variables on 3 response variables.
the Resolution IV design is a very efficient tool for optimizing the formulation of nanoparticles.
we have developed an approach for the formulation of cross-linker free protein based nanoparticles for the delivery of anti-tumor drugs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have demonstrated a simple approach to prepare crosslinker free protein nanoparticles for drug delivery.
the self assembly of protein can be harnessed to form nanoparticles with a controlled release payload, without the use of any crosslinker.
we have developed a novel approach for the self assembly of protein and drug into nanoparticles without using any crosslinker.
